lines.en: label chapthree3:
scene resetwithmaya1
: ...Maya?
lines.zh: : ...Maya?

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : What?...
The seven second intervals separating Maya’s dream-induced twitches disappear along with the reluctant acceptance that I will never see her again.
lines.zh: 隔开 Maya 因梦境而抽搐的七秒间隔消失了,随之消失的,还有「我再也见不到她」那份不甘愿的接受。

lines.en: I think I must have inherited them, as my body interprets this miraculous turn of events as an attack on itself- or at least the remnants of gods still circulating throughout my bloodstream.
lines.zh: 我想我大概是把它们继承了过来,因为我的身体把这奇迹般的转折解读成了对自身的攻击——或者至少是仍在我血液里循环的诸神残骸的攻击。

lines.en: A flood of unfamiliar feelings fills my heart and subsequently the rest of me, draining every last lingering ounce of divinity out of my veins and into a lurking container housing only half of a man.
lines.zh: 一阵陌生的感情涌上心头,继而灌满我全身,把血管里最后一丝残留的神性抽干,倒进一个潜伏着的、只装了半个男人的容器里。

lines.en: Perhaps this will be the wake-up call I need.
lines.zh: 也许这正是我需要的当头棒喝。

lines.en: Or perhaps I’ll take it as proof that there never was a god. For if there {i}was{/i} or if there {i}is,{/i} this is certainly not an act on their behalf.
lines.zh: 又或者,我会把它当作「从来没有过神」的证明。因为无论{i}曾经有过{/i}还是{i}现在有着{/i},这都绝不是他们的手笔。

lines.en: It simply doesn’t match their preferred form of comedy.
lines.zh: 这跟他们偏好的那种喜剧形式根本不符。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya2
Two pairs of empty eyes meet in the darkest corner of a bedroom and exchange absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: 两双空洞的眼睛在卧室最阴暗的角落相遇,彼此什么也没有交换。

lines.en: They latch onto each other because the idea of looking anywhere else reminds them that straying too far from home can be dangerous.
lines.zh: 它们死死咬住对方,因为望向别处这件事本身就在提醒它们:离家太远是危险的。

lines.en: But in that moment, the hosts of each pair of eyes are reminded that there has never been anywhere that has felt like home at all.
lines.zh: 但在那一刻,这两双眼睛的主人同时被提醒:从来就没有哪个地方像过家。

lines.en: And that all they have ever done is stray.
lines.zh: 而她们做过的,只有流浪。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya3
I thank my organs for their constant twisting as they managed to lure me here before anywhere else.
lines.zh: 我感谢我的内脏一直在打结,是它们把我先引到了这里,而不是别处。

lines.en: I thank Ayane for convincing me to look in the first place.
lines.zh: 我感谢 Ayane 说服我一开始就去找。

lines.en: I thank myself and the circumstances and everything I can think of except whatever forces brought us to this dark corner.
lines.zh: 我感谢我自己、感谢境遇、感谢我能想到的一切,唯独不感谢把我们带到这个黑暗角落的那股力量。

lines.en: All that remains at this point is to find a home.
lines.zh: 事到如今,剩下的只有找一个家。

lines.en: To find a place to come back to so neither one of us ever has to stray again.
lines.zh: 找一个能回来的地方,好让我们谁都不必再去流浪。

lines.en: But before that-
lines.zh: 但在此之前——

lines.en: A celebration is in order.
lines.zh: 该先庆祝一下。

lines.en: scene amibreak4
scene everythingg7
scene whygodwhy
scene resetwithmaya4
: AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
: 为什么?……

lines.en: : Why couldn’t I see her?...
lines.zh: : 为什么我看不见她?……

lines.en: : AHHHH! AAAAAAHHH!!!! AAHHHH...HAAHHH...AHAHHHHHH!!
lines.zh: : AHHHH! AAAAAAHHH!!!! AAHHHH...HAAHHH...AHAHHHHHH!!

lines.en: This is not the first time I’ve had the misfortune of feeling the tears of a young girl seep through the fabric of my shirt.
lines.zh: 这不是我第一次倒霉地感觉到年轻女孩的眼泪渗过我衬衫的布料。

lines.en: It is, however, the first time I have not felt an immediate compulsion to get changed.
lines.zh: 但这是第一次,我没有立刻产生想去换件衣服的冲动。

lines.en: These are the most welcome tears I have ever felt.
lines.zh: 这是我感受过的最让人欢迎的眼泪。

lines.en: So why can’t I bring myself to embrace her back?
lines.zh: 那我为什么没法说服自己回抱她呢?

lines.en: Is it because of the shock?
lines.zh: 是因为震惊?

lines.en: Because just moments ago I was unsure of whether or not I’d ever get to experience something like this?
lines.zh: 因为就在片刻之前,我还不确定自己这辈子还能不能经历这样的事?

lines.en: Is it because of fear?
lines.zh: 是因为恐惧?

lines.en: Because I {i}have{/i} subconsciously began to heed her warnings and keep my distance?
lines.zh: 因为我在潜意识里{i}开始{/i}听从她的警告,跟她保持距离?

lines.en: Or is it because I now understand the gravity of exactly what that means?
lines.zh: 还是因为我现在终于明白那意味着什么,明白它有多沉重?

lines.en: And that the world itself is not what will come to an end-
lines.zh: 而将要终结的并不是这个世界本身——

lines.en: But that it would be one of {i}us{/i} that does.
lines.zh: 而是{i}我们{/i}之中的一个。

lines.en: And that is somehow even worse.
lines.zh: 而这在某种意义上甚至更糟。

lines.en: : IT FELT SO REAL!
lines.zh: : 感觉太真实了!

lines.en: : IT FELT LIKE I WAS BACK THERE!
lines.zh: : 感觉就像我真的回到了那里!

lines.en: : AND YOU WERE THERE, BUT...BUT IT WASN’T YOU! IT WAS A FAKE YOU!
lines.zh: : 而且你也在,可是……可是那不是你!那是个假的你!

lines.en: : AND THAT FUCKING CUNT NORIKO WAS THERE TOO! AND...AND MY DESK!
lines.zh: : 还有那个他妈的贱人 Noriko 也在!还有……还有我的书桌!

lines.en: : AND THE CLOCK! AND THE POSTERS! AND THE COMPUTER AND THE NOTEBOOKS AND THAT BLANKET YOU BOUGHT FROM THE THRIFT STORE!
lines.zh: : 还有那个钟!还有海报!还有电脑、笔记本,还有你从二手店买回来的那条毯子!

lines.en: : IT WAS ALL THERE, SENSEI!
lines.zh: : 全都在那里,Sensei!

lines.en: : IT WAS ALL RIGHT THERE! BUT IT WASN’T!
lines.zh: : 就全摆在那儿!可又不是!

lines.en: : IT FELT SO REAL! IT FELT SO REAL!! IT FELT SO REAL!!!
lines.zh: : 感觉太真实了!感觉太真实了!!感觉太真实了!!!

lines.en: : IT TOOK EVERYTHING I HAD TO FIGHT IT, YOU KNOW?! I’M REALLY FUCKING AMAZING, YOU KNOW?!
lines.zh: : 我拼了命才撑过来的,你知道吗?!我他妈真的超厉害的,你知道吗?!

lines.en: : I’M DOING ALL OF THIS FOR YOU, YOU KNOW?!
lines.zh: : 我做这一切都是为了你,你知道吗?!

lines.en: : I DON’T WANT TO LEAVE! I WANT TO STAY HERE WITH YOU!
lines.zh: : 我不想离开!我想留在这里陪你!

lines.en: : I WANT TO STAY! I WANT TO STAY!
lines.zh: : 我想留下!我想留下!

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya5
: I’d appreciate if you’d forget everything I just said.
lines.zh: : 麻烦你把我刚说的一切都忘掉,谢谢。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t think that’s going to happen.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我觉得那不太可能。

lines.en: : How long has it been?
lines.zh: : 过了多久了?

lines.en: : It’s started, right?
lines.zh: : 已经开始了,对吧?

lines.en: : Yeah...
: It hasn’t been very long, I don’t think. But it felt weird being on the rooftop without you, so...
lines.zh: : 我想应该没过多久。不过天台上没有你,感觉很怪,所以……

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya6
: Hah...
: You really are hopeless without me after all...
lines.zh: : 看来没有我,你还真是完全不行啊……

lines.en: scene black
Maya releases her grip on my shirt and the markings left by her tears quickly turn from hot to cold in what seems like a direct mirror of her mood tonight.
lines.zh: Maya 松开抓着我衬衫的手,她眼泪留下的痕迹很快由热转冷,仿佛正是她今晚心情的直接映照。

lines.en: She wipes the ones not caught by my clothing off with her hands before bringing them to her own shirt and causing us to match in one more subtle way.
lines.zh: 她用手擦掉那些没被我衣服吸走的眼泪,又把手抹到自己的衬衫上,于是我们又以一种更微妙的方式变得一致了。

lines.en: The good thing is that only one set of empty eyes remains now.
lines.zh: 好消息是,现在只剩下一双空洞的眼睛了。

lines.en: The bad thing is that they belong to me-
lines.zh: 坏消息是,那双眼睛是我的——

lines.en: And that even now, I can’t help but put myself first.
lines.zh: 而且即便到了现在,我还是忍不住把自己放在第一位。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya7
: What? Why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : 干嘛?你为什么那样看着我?

lines.en: : If this is about my little outburst just now, I’d like to make it known that I was extremely disoriented after waking up from a nightmare and-
lines.zh: : 如果是为了我刚才那通小小的情绪爆发,我想声明一下,我是刚从噩梦里醒来,整个人极度混乱——

lines.en: : I thought you were {i}gone...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我以为你{i}不在了{/i}……

lines.en: : I came in here twice...and I couldn’t see you either time...I don’t understand...
lines.zh: : 我进来过两次……两次都没看见你……我不明白……

lines.en: : If it wasn’t for Sensei, I never would have-
lines.zh: : 如果不是 Sensei,我永远都不可能——

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya8
: Ayane, if it wasn’t for you, I’d probably still be moping around on the roof right now. You’re the one who helped me get off of my ass and actually do something.
lines.zh: : Ayane,如果不是你,我大概现在还在天台上自怨自艾。是你让我从屁股上抬起来,真的去做点什么。

lines.en: : Yes, but-
lines.zh: : 是,可是——

lines.en: : Don’t beat yourself up about the weird mechanics surrounding the end of the world. Especially now that we know Maya doesn’t really understand them either.
lines.zh: : 别为世界末日那套诡异机制自责了。更何况现在我们知道了,Maya 自己其实也搞不懂。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya9
: Excuse me- I never claimed to be an expert at this. But, just for curiosity’s sake, exactly what are you referring to right now?
lines.zh: : 不好意思——我可从没自称过是这方面的专家。不过纯粹出于好奇,你现在具体指的是什么?

lines.en: : The fact that Ayane’s back again and not pregnant.
lines.zh: : 指的是 Ayane 又回来了,而且没有怀孕这件事。

lines.en: : Yeah, I still don’t believe that.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我还是不信。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya10
: Why don’t you ever believe me when I tell you I’m not pregnant?! I know my body better than you do, Maya!
lines.zh: : 为什么我说我没怀孕你从来都不信?!我比你更了解我自己的身体,Maya!

lines.en: : What’s more concerning than that is how you managed to wake me up.
lines.zh: : 比这更让我在意的是,你到底是怎么把我叫醒的。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思?

lines.en: : I mean that I have tried that with you many times in the past and, without beating around the bush, it has always ended up rather catastrophically.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是,我以前也这样试过你很多次,恕我直言,结果每次都相当惨烈。

lines.en: : Catastrophically {i}how?{/i}
lines.zh: : 惨烈成{i}什么样{/i}?

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya11
: It...would probably be best to leave the details out for now.
lines.zh: : 细节……现在大概还是先不说了比较好。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t like that at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我可一点也不喜欢这个回答。

lines.en: : The fact that Ayane wasn’t able to see me is...curious, though. And calls into question a number of different things I’ve never really thought about before.
lines.zh: : 不过 Ayane 看不见我这件事……确实耐人寻味。它让我开始怀疑一大堆我以前从没认真想过的事。

lines.en: : It’s a shame she’s going to forget all of this yet again once we make it back to the roof.
lines.zh: : 只可惜等我们回到天台,她大概又要把这一切全都忘掉了。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya12
: You think I’m going to...forget again?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我……又会忘掉?

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t I? That has happened 100%% of the times you’ve shown up during a reset. I have no reason to believe it won’t happen again.
lines.zh: : 不然呢?你在重置期间出现过的次数里,这种事发生的概率是 100%%。我没有理由相信这次不会。

lines.en: : That was just one time, though...right? Nobody knows if that’ll happen-
lines.zh: : 可那只有一次而已……对吧?谁也不知道会不会——

lines.en: : Nobody knows, that is correct. But I wouldn’t get my hopes up if I were you.
lines.zh: : 谁也不知道,这没错。但换作是我,我不会抱太大希望。

lines.en: : Plus, I’m kind of rooting for your memory to get wiped right now so I don’t have to live with the embarrassment of all the things I just said.
lines.zh: : 再说了,我现在其实还有点盼着你的记忆被清掉,这样我就不必带着刚才说的那些丢人的话活下去了。

lines.en: : It’s bad enough that {i}he{/i} heard them. And, if it weren’t for the {i}dream{/i} I just had, I’d call the idea of {i}you{/i} hearing those things as well my worst nightmare.
lines.zh: : 光是{i}他{/i}听到了就已经够糟了。如果不是刚做了那个{i}梦{/i},我会把「{i}你{/i}也听到了那些话」这件事称为我最可怕的噩梦。

lines.en: : You should be a little nicer to her, Maya. Ayane was willing to sacrifice her life to go out and look for you, you know.
lines.zh: : 你对她好一点吧,Maya。Ayane 可是连命都豁出去,出去找你了,你知道吗。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya13
: I’m both flattered and thankful...truly. But what the two of you did was not only a complete shot in the dark, but an extremely foolish one at that.
lines.zh: : 我既受宠若惊又心存感激……真的。但你们俩做的事不只是完全瞎蒙,而且蠢得要命。

lines.en: : What would you have done if you attempted to wake me up and something horrible happened to me? How would you live with yourselves knowing that {i}you{/i} were the cause?
lines.zh: : 如果你们试着把我叫醒,结果我身上发生了什么可怕的事,你们打算怎么办?知道{i}自己{/i}就是原因,你们还要怎么活下去?

lines.en: : Probably the same way we’d live knowing we left this place...or...{i}time{/i} without you.
lines.zh: : 大概就跟我们明知自己离开了这个地方……或者这个{i}时代{/i},却把你丢下时的活法一样吧。

lines.en: : Plus, even if {i}anyone can do it,{/i} resetting the world isn't my job. It's yours.
lines.zh: : 再说,就算{i}谁都能做{/i},重置世界也不是我的活。那是你的活。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya14
: Sure. Leave the praying to one person who hates the gods more than you do. Fantastic idea.
lines.zh: : 好啊。把祈祷这件事交给一个比你更恨神的人。真是绝妙的主意。

lines.en: : So...what happens now? Should we...maybe check the other dorm rooms?
lines.zh: : 那么……现在怎么办?我们要不要……去查查其他宿舍房间?

lines.en: : If Sensei was able to see {i}you,{/i} maybe he can-
lines.zh: : 既然 Sensei 能看见{i}你{/i},也许他还能——

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya15
: Unlikely. And it’s not something we should risk regardless.
lines.zh: : 不太可能。而且不管怎么说,这事我们都不该去冒险。

lines.en: : Judging the flow of time here is nigh impossible as it seems to come to a standstill. But given the fact that this is the first time in history that I’ve been the last one to wake up, I don’t want to take any chances.
lines.zh: : 在这里判断时间的流动几乎是不可能的,因为它看起来已经停滞了。但鉴于这是有史以来第一次我成了最后一个醒来的人,我不想冒任何风险。

lines.en: : We need to get this over with as quickly as possible. And, should you still be there when we return, {i}then{/i} we can talk about what’s going to happen next.
lines.zh: : 我们得尽快把这事儿了结。如果回去之后你还在那儿,我们{i}再{/i}谈接下来怎么办。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya16
: After we decide on a name for the baby, that is.
lines.zh: : 当然,是在我们给孩子取好名字之后。

lines.en: : Ha ha ha. Very funny.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。真好笑。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya17
: On a brighter note...thank you, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 说点开心的事吧……谢谢你,Ayane。

lines.en: : I greatly appreciate it and now feel quite horrible with myself for all of the times I watched you fade away into nothingness.
lines.zh: : 我真的很感激。也因此,我对过去那些看着你一点点消散成虚无的时刻,感到相当愧疚。

lines.en: : I’m going to ignore that last part and just pretend you only said “Thank you,” okay?
lines.zh: : 那最后一句我就当没听见,只当你是说了句「谢谢」,行吗?

lines.en: scene black
What Maya said about the flow of time here must be accurate as everything seems to come to a standstill while we’re inside of the dorms.
lines.zh: Maya 说的关于这里时间流动的话大概没错,因为我们在宿舍里的时候,一切似乎都停滞了。

lines.en: In fact, I’m so caught up in my head about the prospect of how this will play out next time that I can’t even bring myself to focus on the girls as they change back into their casual clothes in front of me.
lines.zh: 事实上,我满脑子都在想下次会怎么收场,甚至没法把注意力放在当着我的面换回便服的女孩们身上。

lines.en: Maya shows restraint at first, but Ayane’s adamance about no one leaving each other’s sight again quickly coerces her into changing her stance and...
lines.zh: Maya 一开始还收敛着,可 Ayane 坚持说谁也不能再离开谁的视线,很快就逼得她改了主意,然后……

lines.en: Well, paired with the fact that Maya has, once again, all but confessed her feelings to me, taking off her clothes must not seem like that big of a deal in the end.
lines.zh: 好吧,再加上 Maya 又一次等于向我表白了,说到底,把衣服脱下来大概也算不上什么大事了。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
It’s funny, isn’t it? How quickly the idea of tragedy can cause one’s mind to spiral out of control. And how the overturning of said tragedy brings us right back to the starting line.
lines.zh: 真可笑,不是吗?念头里的悲剧能多快让一个人的心智失控。而那悲剧被推翻之后,我们又立刻被拽回了起跑线。

lines.en: Somewhere, a wooden carving of a god is laughing itself to death inside of a glass box, knowing full well that it is the icon of all that is unjust in this world.
lines.zh: 在某个地方,一尊神的木雕正在玻璃盒子里笑得要死,它心知肚明,自己正是这世上一切不公的图腾。

lines.en: And that each and every one of us who pay admission prices to gaze into its empty eyes are attempting to translate and disfigure that laughter into a series of noises that provide us some form of comfort.
lines.zh: 而我们每一个掏了门票钱去凝视它那双空洞眼睛的人,都在试着把那种笑声翻译、扭曲成一连串能让我们得到某种安慰的噪音。

lines.en: I ask you, what is there to be comfortable about here?
lines.zh: 我问你们,这里有什么值得安慰的?

lines.en: How can anyone find comfort knowing that, at any second, the things they need the most can be stripped away without warning?
lines.zh: 明知自己最需要的东西随时可能在毫无预警的情况下被夺走,谁又能安心得下来?

lines.en: There is no reason to laugh.
lines.zh: 没什么好笑的。

lines.en: There is no reason to smile.
lines.zh: 没什么值得微笑的。

lines.en: scene tree3
AND YET WE SMILE AS WIDE AS WE CAN
lines.zh: 可我们还是笑得要多开有多开

lines.en: WE PUT OUR LEFT LEG IN FRONT OF OUR RIGHT
lines.zh: 我们把左腿迈到右腿前面

lines.en: OUR RIGHT IN FRONT OF OUR LEFT
lines.zh: 再把右腿迈到左腿前面

lines.en: AND WE ALL WALK IN SINGLE FILE LINES TOWARD THE SAME THING
lines.zh: 然后排成一列纵队,朝着同一个东西走去

lines.en: A WORLD FULL OF JOY
lines.zh: 一个充满喜悦的世界

lines.en: A WORLD FULL OF PEACE
lines.zh: 一个充满和平的世界

lines.en: A WORLD THAT CAN NOT EXIST BECAUSE THE IDEA OF SUCH A PLACE IS AN INHERENT FALLACY IN THE FACE OF WHAT EVERY GOD TRULY WANTS
lines.zh: 一个根本不可能存在的世界,因为这样的地方,在每一个神真正想要的东西面前,本身就是个彻头彻尾的谬误

lines.en: TO CONSUME
lines.zh: 去吞噬

lines.en: TO GROW
lines.zh: 去生长

lines.en: TO SURVIVE
lines.zh: 去存活

lines.en: TO THRIVE
lines.zh: 去繁荣

lines.en: AND TO HAVE ALL THAT YOU DO NOT
lines.zh: 去占有你没有的一切

lines.en: BECAUSE IT IS NOT GOD WHO GRANTS US POWER
lines.zh: 因为赐予我们力量的从来不是神

lines.en: IT IS POWER THAT MAKES US GODS
lines.zh: 是力量把我们变成了神

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya18
: Wow...
: Was the moon always that big?...
lines.zh: : 月亮一直都那么大吗?……

lines.en: : I...don’t think so...
lines.zh: : 我……不这么觉得……

lines.en: : It’s almost like it’s...{i}growing.{/i}
lines.zh: : 简直像是……{i}在变大{/i}。

lines.en: : We should hurry.
lines.zh: : 我们得快点。

lines.en: : Things have been changing rather rapidly in a multitude of ways as of late, and very few of those changes have actually been beneficial.
lines.zh: : 最近这段时间,各种事情都在以相当快的速度变化,而其中真正算得上好事的少之又少。

lines.en: : The last thing we need is a giant moon crashing into us as we’re attempting to reset the world.
lines.zh: : 我们最不需要的,就是在试图重置世界的时候,被一颗巨大的月亮砸中。

lines.en: : The fact that I took that sentence seriously is a good indicator of how weird my life has suddenly become.
lines.zh: : 我居然把这句话当真了,这本身就足以说明我的人生突然变得有多离谱。

lines.en: : Welcome to the club, Ayane. We meet once every four months or so.
lines.zh: : 欢迎加入俱乐部,Ayane。我们大概每四个月聚一次。

lines.en: : Oooooh, we should make special “end of the world” t-shirts for next time. If Maya’s theory is wrong and I’m still around, that is.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦,下次我们应该做一批「世界末日」专属 T 恤。当然,前提是 Maya 的理论错了,而我还在这儿。

lines.en: : Can you two please take this seriously?
lines.zh: : 你们俩能认真点吗?

lines.en: : Hey, I don’t even know what I’m supposed to do yet. Sensei told me hours ago that you’d fill me in on all of the details, but then you weren’t here and we had that big heartfelt reunion and-
lines.zh: : 嘿,我连自己该做什么都还不知道呢。Sensei 几小时前就说你会把所有细节告诉我,结果你人不在,然后我们就来了那场感人至深的重逢,而且——

lines.en: : Just stop talking and hug him.
lines.zh: : 别说了,抱住他就是了。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya19
: Wow. If I knew it was that easy, I would have started hours ago.
lines.zh: : 哇。早知道这么简单,我几小时前就动手了。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya20
: If you’d started hours ago, you’d likely be conversing with a version of me significantly more {i}chipper{/i} than the one you’re seeing right now. Now close your eyes.
lines.zh: : 你要是几小时前就动手,现在跟你说话的我,大概会比你现在看到的这个{i}精神抖擞{/i}得多。好了,闭上眼睛。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya21
: Maya, you don’t have to hide your excitement about hugging Sensei from me. If there is anyone who understands that feeling, it is Ayane Amamiya.
lines.zh: : Maya,你不用在我面前掩饰想抱 Sensei 的兴奋。要说有谁懂那种心情,那就是 Ayane Amamiya 了。

lines.en: : I am excited to open my eyes and have you gone. {i}That{/i} is what I’m excited for.
lines.zh: : 我兴奋的是,睁开眼之后你已经不在了。我兴奋的是{i}这个{/i}。

lines.en: : Aww, but I think we make a cute little family. I’m the mom, Sensei is the dad, and you’re the gardener he’s having an affair with.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,可我觉得我们组成了一个可爱的小家庭呢。我是妈妈,Sensei 是爸爸,而你是他出轨的那个园丁。

lines.en: : Ha. So you {i}are{/i} pregnant after all.
lines.zh: : 哈。这么说来你果然还{i}是{/i}怀孕了。

lines.en: : Am not.
lines.zh: : 才没有。

lines.en: : Are too.
lines.zh: : 明明就有。

lines.en: : Am not.
lines.zh: : 才没有。

lines.en: : Are- wait, why am I even going along with this when I’m supposed to be praying?
lines.zh: : 明明——等等,我明明该在祈祷,为什么还要陪你玩这个?

lines.en: : You know, out of all of these that I’ve been through so far, this one is definitely the weirdest.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,在我经历过的这么多次里,这次绝对是最怪的。

lines.en: : I really wish I could say the same.
lines.zh: : 我真希望我也能这么说。

lines.en: : And I really wish that-
lines.zh: : 而我真希望——

: Is it over? Can I open my eyes?
lines.zh: : 结束了吗?我可以睁眼了吗?

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya23
: You’re...still here?
lines.zh: : 你……还在?

lines.en: : I think so. Unless I’m not actually the real Ayane and was just replaced with a fake one who looks exactly the same and loves Sensei just as much.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在。除非我已经不是真正的 Ayane,而是被换成了长得一模一样、也同样爱着 Sensei 的冒牌货。

lines.en: : Probably even more, now that we’ve been through an apocalypse together.
lines.zh: : 说不定爱得更多,毕竟我们一起经历了一场末日。

lines.en: : We’re back, right?
lines.zh: : 我们回来了,对吧?

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya24
: Uhh...yeah. I think so.
lines.zh: : 呃……嗯。我想是的。

lines.en: : Do we always respawn in Sensei’s office? This seems like a weird starting point.
lines.zh: : 我们每次都在 Sensei 的办公室里重生吗?这起点好像有点怪。

lines.en: : I mean...it’s not {i}entirely{/i} unheard of. But it’s also not like it’s the...usual process or...
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……也不是{i}完全{/i}没听说过。但这也算不上是……常规流程之类的……

lines.en: : You’re still {i}you,{/i} right? Ayane didn’t, like...absorb any of your memories...or something?
lines.zh: : 你还是{i}你{/i},对吧?Ayane 应该没有……像是吸收掉你的什么记忆……什么的吧?

lines.en: : Is that a thing that can happen?
lines.zh: : 那种事会发生吗?

lines.en: : I have no idea. This is an entirely new experience for me.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道。这对我来说也是全新的体验。

lines.en: : That said, I think it would be best for the three of us to-
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来,我觉得我们三个最好还是——

lines.en: : Senpai! Are you in- woah! Okay! I didn’t see anything! Don’t kill me!
lines.zh: : Senpai!你在——哇哦!好的!我什么都没看见!别杀我!

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya25
: Hah...or we can wait until later to talk about this. That’s fine too.
lines.zh: : 哈……或者我们也可以晚点再聊这个。这样也行。

lines.en: : Is there something you need, Imani?
lines.zh: : 有什么事吗,Imani?

lines.en: : Yeah. I need you to do your friggin’ job instead of mackin’ it with your students all morning.
lines.zh: : 有。我需要你他妈的干点正事,而不是整个上午都跟你的学生亲热。

lines.en: : Just how many sexual encounters am I gonna walk into in here?
lines.zh: : 我这到底要在里头撞见多少次性爱场面啊?

lines.en: : Um...hopefully zero.
lines.zh: : 呃……希望是零次。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya26
: And why aren’t you two in uniform? It’s one thing to show up late, but to show up late {i}and{/i} improperly dressed, {i}AND{/i} about to have a threesome in the office?
lines.zh: : 还有你们俩怎么没穿校服?迟到是一回事,迟到{i}还{/i}穿得不合规范,{i}而且{/i}还要在办公室里搞三人性爱,这又是另一回事了吧?

lines.en: : Listen, I’m trying to be the cool student teacher and all, but I’ve gotta put my foot down somewhere. At least fix {i}one{/i} of those things, yo.
lines.zh: : 听着,我是想当个酷一点的实习老师什么的,但我总得有个底线。至少把其中{i}一样{/i}改掉,拜托。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya27
: So...threesomes are okay as long as I'm wearing my uniform?
lines.zh: : 所以……只要我穿着校服,三人性爱就没关系是吧?

lines.en: : What is it with you and threesomes, man? What kind of insatiable beast requires a minimum of two girls for every sex act?
lines.zh: : 你跟三人性爱到底什么仇什么怨啊,老兄?什么样的欲求不满的野兽,每一次性行为都得至少两个女孩才够?

lines.en: : I am too exhausted from everything I just went through, so-
lines.zh: : 我刚经历完那一堆事,累得不行,所以——

lines.en: : Yeah, I bet you are.
lines.zh: : 是啊,我看也是。

lines.en: : ...So I’m going to just agree to whatever papers you need me to sign so you can be on your way.
lines.zh: : ……所以我打算你要我签什么文件我都签,好让你赶紧走人。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya28
: Papers? What? No. Class started an hour ago and you’ve been in here going to town on these two  the whole time.
lines.zh: : 文件?什么?不是。课一小时前就开始了,而你一直在这里对着她们俩忙活个不停。

lines.en: : Imani, they’re fully clothed. Does it really look like we just finished having a threesome?
lines.zh: : Imani,她们穿得整整齐齐的。真有那么像我们刚搞完三人性爱吗?

lines.en: : Well, sorry Senpai, but I’m struggling to think of another scenario that would lead to a full-on group hug like that.
lines.zh: : 嗯,抱歉啊 Senpai,但我实在想不出还有什么别的场景能导致那样一个彻头彻尾的集体拥抱。

lines.en: : That’s just one of the steps to resetting the world.
lines.zh: : 那只是重置世界的其中一个步骤。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya29
: Got it. That makes a lot more sense.
lines.zh: : 懂了。这就说得通多了。

lines.en: : We’re sorry. We just...really had to talk to Sensei about-
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我们只是……真的得跟 Sensei 谈谈——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah, yeah. I don’t need your excuses. Just go wait in the hall while I deal with this guy and then we’ll all walk back to class together.
lines.zh: : 行行行。我不需要你的解释。去走廊等着,我处理完这家伙,然后我们一起回教室。

lines.en: : Come on, Ayane. We can postpone our full discussion until later.
lines.zh: : 走吧,Ayane。我们完整的讨论可以推迟到以后。

lines.en: : Oh...Okay. Yeah.
: I guess we’ll just...go wait out there and...leave Imani and Sensei to talk about threesomes together.
lines.zh: : 那我们就……去外面等着,然后……把 Imani 和 Sensei 留下聊三人性爱。

lines.en: : I highly doubt that will be the conversation topic we land on, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我相当怀疑最后落到的话题会是那个,Ayane。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya30
: Good...
lines.zh: : 那就好……

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya31
: What?
lines.zh: : 干嘛?

lines.en: : Nothing. I’m just waiting for you to {i}deal with me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 没什么。我只是在等你{i}来处理我{/i}。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya32

: You’ve gotta come to class, man. If you keep slacking off like this, they’re gonna give all your students to me and then you won’t be able to afford taking all fifty of your girlfriends out on dates anymore.
lines.zh: : 你得来上课啊,老兄。你要是继续这么摸鱼,他们会把你所有的学生都交给我,到时候你可就养不起你那五十个女朋友、带不起她们约会了。

lines.en: : My bad. Something just...came up this morning.
lines.zh: : 我的错。今天早上只是……冒出来点事。

lines.en: : Yeah...now that I’m closer, I can kinda see that. You look really tired, Senpai. Everything okay?
lines.zh: : 是啊……现在离近了,我倒是能看出来。你看起来真的很累,Senpai。一切都还好吗?

lines.en: : You’re not worried about today, are you? Cause I already told you I’d handle the announcement and everything. I just...you know, need you {i}in the room{/i} so Makoto doesn’t think I’m overstepping again.
lines.zh: : 你不是在担心今天的事吧?我说过了,宣布什么的我来处理就好。我只是……你知道的,需要你{i}在场{/i},免得 Makoto 又觉得我越权了。

lines.en: : Announcement? What announcement?
lines.zh: : 宣布?什么宣布?

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya33
: The club announcement, Senpai! The Great Migration!
lines.zh: : 社团宣布啊,Senpai!大迁徙!

lines.en: : The...what?
lines.zh: : 那个……什么?

lines.en: : The deadline for the new school policy kicks in tomorrow! A bunch of clubs got replaced with new ones and everybody needs to sign up for one in the next 24 hours!
lines.zh: : 新校规的截止日期明天就生效了!一大堆社团被新社团取代,所有人都得在 24 小时内选一个报上!

lines.en: : Or what?
lines.zh: : 不然呢?

lines.en: : Or-
lines.zh: : 不然——

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya34
: Wait, yeah. Or what?
lines.zh: : 等等,对啊。不然呢?

lines.en: : They wouldn’t actually expel people over that, would they?
lines.zh: : 他们总不至于为这种事开除人吧,会吗?

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya33
: Either way! We’ve got a job to do! And we can’t do that job from our office!
lines.zh: : 不管怎样!我们有活要干!而且这活在我们的办公室里可干不了!

lines.en: : {i}My{/i} office.
lines.zh: : 是{i}我的{/i}办公室。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya35
: But I don’t {i}have{/i} an office and I want you to share with me...
lines.zh: : 可我{i}没有{/i}办公室啊,而我想让你跟我合用……

lines.en: : Borrow Wakana’s office. You two are friends now, right?
lines.zh: : 去借 Wakana 的办公室啊。你俩现在是朋友了,对吧?

lines.en: : She put a sign on her door saying “No Imani” which, not gonna lie, is a {i}pretty bad{/i} look for her since I’m the only black girl around here.
lines.zh: : 她在门上贴了张「Imani 禁止入内」的纸条,说实话,这对她形象可{i}不太好{/i},毕竟这一带就我一个黑人女孩。

lines.en: : Yeah...I think she might want to take that down before there’s a misunderstanding.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我觉得她最好在引起误会之前把那张纸撕下来。

lines.en: : {i}You’ll{/i} never try to keep me out of your office...right, Senpai?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}永远不会把我挡在你的办公室外面……对吧,Senpai?

lines.en: : Just please knock from now on. It’s not really good for me if you think I’m having threesomes all the time.
lines.zh: : 以后请敲门就好。你老觉得我一天到晚在搞三人性爱,这对我可不怎么好。

lines.en: scene resetwithmaya32
: I don’t know, man. I think that makes you seem pretty damn cool. But hey, if you’d rather me look at you as some kind of pansy ass cherry boy, I can do that too.
lines.zh: : 这可不好说,老兄。我觉得这反倒让你看起来相当酷。不过话说回来,如果你更希望我把你看成某种娘兮兮的处男,那我也可以照办。

lines.en: : Okay, on that note, we should probably get to class now.
lines.zh: : 好,既然话都说到这份上了,我们大概该去上课了。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. {i}That’s{/i} the note that gets you to class. Not the morning bell or the weight of future generations that should be pressing down upon your shoulders at all times.
lines.zh: : 哦,对啊。原来让你去上课的是{i}这{/i}句话。不是晨铃,也不是本该时刻压在你肩上的、未来几代人的重量。

lines.en: : After you, my king.
lines.zh: : 您先请,我的国王。

lines.en: scene black
Well...it looks like I’m being thrown right back into the thick of things without being given a chance to process all that’s happened over the last...however long we were at the end of the world for.
lines.zh: 好吧……看来我连消化一下在这……不管我们在世界末日待了多久……里发生的一切的机会都没有,就又被直接扔回了漩涡中央。

lines.en: I’m not sure what to make of the fact that Ayane has managed to retain her memories of the reset, but...that can’t possibly be a bad thing, can it?
lines.zh: 我不确定该怎么看待 Ayane 居然保住了关于重置的记忆这件事,但……那总不可能是坏事吧,会吗?

lines.en: Sure, it might be putting an aeon’s worth of unnecessary strain on her already over-exhausted mind, but...
lines.zh: 当然,这也许给她本就过度疲惫的大脑加上了一整个永劫那么多的多余负担,可是……

lines.en: Maybe it could bring us closer together?
lines.zh: 也许这能让我们靠得更近?

lines.en: The opposite goes for Maya, though.
lines.zh: 不过对 Maya 来说,情况正好相反。

lines.en: How will {i}she{/i} handle the idea of someone else joining us up there?
lines.zh: {i}她{/i}会怎么看待有别人加入我们天台的事?

lines.en: How will {i}she{/i} view the one thing the two of us can freely share now that it’s being infiltrated?
lines.zh: {i}她{/i}又会怎么看待那件原本只有我们两人可以自由分享、如今却被入侵了的东西?

lines.en: I ask myself a variety of questions just like this on the way back to the classroom.
lines.zh: 在回教室的路上,我问了自己一大堆诸如此类的问题。

lines.en: But the one that I have trouble answering-
lines.zh: 但我答不上来的那一个——

lines.en: Is if she’ll wake up next time.
lines.zh: 是下一次她还会不会醒来。
